title: Worked Examples: Address-Amendment Vehicle Charge and Garaging Changes (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
## Rule

On an address amendment of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate, the address-amendment vehicle charge follows the garaging changes recorded on the named insured's Cardinal Personal Auto Policy records within the past month, one garaging change per vehicle moved, and is worked from the address-amendment rate:

- **two or more garaging changes:** the rate plus half the rate for each vehicle beyond the first, that half-rate addition rounded down to the whole dollar — the addition is half the rate multiplied by the number of vehicles beyond the first, and that one amount is rounded down before it is added to the rate;
- **no garaging change, only the mailing address changed:** half the rate, rounded down to the whole dollar;
- **exactly one garaging change:** the rate.

"Within the past month" covers garaging changes whose recorded date is less than one whole month before today, whole months being counted from the recorded date to today.

## Examples (hypothetical rates)

| Rate | Garaging changes in the past month | Working | Vehicle charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15.00 | 0 | half of 15.00 is 7.50, rounded down | 7.00 |
| 15.00 | 1 | the rate | 15.00 |
| 15.00 | 2 | 15.00 plus (half of 15.00 for one vehicle is 7.50, rounded down to 7.00) | 22.00 |
| 15.00 | 3 | 15.00 plus (half of 15.00 for two vehicles is 15.00) | 30.00 |
| 15.00 | 4 | 15.00 plus (half of 15.00 for three vehicles is 22.50, rounded down to 22.00) | 37.00 |
| 5.00 | 0 | half of 5.00 is 2.50, rounded down | 2.00 |
| 5.00 | 2 | 5.00 plus (2.50, rounded down to 2.00) | 7.00 |
| 20.00 | 3 | 20.00 plus (half of 20.00 for two vehicles is 20.00) | 40.00 |

The rate itself is never rounded; only the half-rate amount is.
